_A_MODAL_WIZARD_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: This component is a combination of a modal window (AModal) and a wizard (AWizard). You can use almost all props from AModal and AWizard.
_A_MODAL_WIZARD_PROPS_SCROLL_TO_TOP_ON_S: Determines whether the modal body scrolls to the top when the active wizard step changes.
_A_MODAL_WIZARD_PROPS_IS_SAVE_BUTTON_LAS: The save button is only on the last step of the wizard.
_A_MODAL_WIZARD_PROPS_ARIA_LABEL_DESCRIP: Name of the wizard; empty by default, the modal is named by its heading.
_A_MODAL_WIZARD_LAST_STEP_DESCRIPTION_: is-save-button-last-step-only shows the save button only on the last step.
